learning_outcomes.text: Have basic knowledge about the types and operating principles of avionic systems. Know the operating principle of the Collision Warning System. Have basic knowledge about the elements and operating principles of Inertial Navigation Systems (INS). Know the operating principles of Gyro-Gimballed and Analytical (Strapdown) Inertial Navigation Systems, and be able to model and analyze INS errors. Have basic knowledge about the types and configuration of Ground and Radio Navigation Systems, and know the operating principles of the Doppler reference system and VOR/DME aircraft positioning systems. Have basic knowledge about Satellite Radio-Navigation Systems, and know the operating principles of the Global Positioning System (GPS) and Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS). Be able to analyze GPS data, calculate user position based on this data, and know the principles of supporting INS with external navigation information. Have basic knowledge about the elements and configuration of the flight control system, and know the principles and use of Autopilot. Know the operating principle of longitudinal and lateral motion control systems.

syllabus_topics: Classification of avionic systems, General information about geotechnics, radiotechnics and astronomical navigation instruments and systems
Classification of avionic systems, General information about geotechnics, radiotechnics and astronomical navigation instruments and systems
Collision Warning System, Navigation systems based on the use of Doppler radar
Elements and basic principles of Inertial Navigation Systems (INS)
Basics and configuration of satellite radio navigation systems
Global Positioning System (GPS), GPS system errors and elimination methods, Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS)
Supporting INS with external navigation information, Supporting INS with GPS schemes
Flight control system elements and configuration
